title: Konzilo design file
description: Numeric lengths are pixels at the default browser setting. Fluid min/max are narrow/wide-window endpoints. CSS is stored in rem; shadow and frame lengths remain px. Missing input leaves use generator defaults. All generated Surfaces have checked roles in both modes. Exports require a passing contrast matrix.

format.description: The shape of this file, raised only when that shape breaks. Neither project.version, a client's review version, nor resolved.generator-version, the generator that made the values.

menu.description: The client's own menu, which the tool's preview and the presentation show in place of the sample menu: the top level is the link menu and the large menu's headings, and the items under each its links. Not design: no input, fingerprint, CSS or site reads it.

footer.description: The client's own words in the footer's cells, each in place of the sample's where the tool's preview and the presentation show the footer; a cell left out keeps the sample's. The upper band's A1 is the brand, which the identity gives. Not design: no input, fingerprint, CSS or site reads it.

b1.description: Social media, one network a line, such as LinkedIn or Email; a network the library has an icon for shows as its icon, any other as its name.

a2.description: A short statement presenting the brand. Each line stands on a line of its own.

b2.description: Links for navigation, by their words. Left out, the top level of the menu shown.

a1.description: The address. Each line stands on a line of its own.

b1.description: The registration number and registered office. Each line stands on a line of its own.

a2.description: Links to policies, by their words.

b2.description: Links to change privacy settings and revoke consents, by their words.

color.description: The shadow's colour choices, and border: each Surface's own border role, a quiet edge that follows the Surface and the mode.

850.description: Dark mode's own step for the light bands (2026-11-11). A file resolved before it has none.

975.description: Dark mode's own step for the page (2026-11-11). A file resolved before it has none.

theme.description: Literal colours for a consumer that cannot read light-dark(): the primary brand seed, exact, and the light page colour.
